items.source: If WebFluxConfigurer does not expose some setting that needs to be configured, consider switching to an advanced mode by removing the @EnableWebFlux annotation and extending directly from WebFluxConfigurationSupport or DelegatingWebFluxConfiguration -- the latter allows detecting and delegating to one or more WebFluxConfigurer configuration classes.
items.translation: 如果 `WebFluxConfigurer` 未暴露某些需要配置的设置，请考虑切换到高级模式：移除 `@EnableWebFlux` 注解，并直接扩展 WebFluxConfigurationSupport 或 DelegatingWebFluxConfiguration ——后者可检测并委托给一个或多个 `WebFluxConfigurer` 配置类。

items.source: Only one @Configuration class should have the @EnableWebFlux annotation in order to import the Spring WebFlux configuration. There can however be multiple @Configuration classes that implement WebFluxConfigurer that customize the provided configuration.
items.translation: 应只有一个带有 `@EnableWebFlux` 注解的 `@Configuration` 类用于导入 Spring WebFlux 配置。然而，可以有多个实现 `WebFluxConfigurer` 的 `@Configuration` 类来自定义提供的配置。

items.source: To customize the imported configuration, implement WebFluxConfigurer and one or more of its methods:
items.translation: 要自定义导入的配置，请实现 WebFluxConfigurer 及其一个或多个方法：
